removed_attempted_paragraph:
\paragraph{Attempted Goop3D extension.}
An exploratory Goop3D extension completed six 25,000-update training endpoints, with base-only and mixed-graph arms at three paired seeds. Its autonomous comparison remained incomplete, and a subsequent observed-history analysis did not complete auditing. We therefore report no Goop3D accuracy. All incomplete outcomes and unsuccessful analysis attempts are retained in the reproducibility material.
main_addition: The separate Goop3D 25k observed-test comparison likewise narrows the risk gap, but fixed-random exposure improves only one of three seeds (Appendix~\ref{sec:goop3d-25k-exposure}).
